note: Development measurements on one local workstation. Runs 1-3 precede checkpoint optimization; run 4 adds scheduling metrics; run 5 adds classified failures and memory samples. Different durations/AI outcomes prevent a controlled capacity comparison. No WAN or physical-device claim. Run 6 is the 15-minute endurance baseline before limited-exit policies. Run 7 records the post-exit scheduling failure during concurrent browser activity. Run 8 is the repeat without the test browser/extra service; it also failed scheduling. Run 9 measures affected-raid rollback; declared development gates passed. Run 10 is the source-fingerprinted 15-minute limited-exit-era movement endurance pass; it predates sector content. Run 11 measures the sector/v6 build for 60 seconds; movement workload only.
